question: 请按血站汇总2023年的全血献血次数并按次数降序
baseline_sql: SELECT b.InstID, b.OrgName, COUNT(*) AS Times FROM Stat_Collection a JOIN Pub_OrgAddress b ON a.BTSID=b.InstID WHERE a.BCDate>='2023-01-01' AND a.BCDate<'2024-01-01' AND a.BCType='0' GROUP BY b.InstID, b.OrgName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: 统计2023年每个城市的成分血采集量
baseline_sql: SELECT b.City, SUM(a.BCPVolume) AS Volume FROM Stat_Collection a JOIN Pub_OrgAddress b ON a.BTSID=b.InstID WHERE a.BCDate>='2023-01-01' AND a.BCDate<'2024-01-01' AND a.BCType='1' GROUP BY b.City

question: 宁波市2023年成分血采集量是多少
baseline_sql: SELECT SUM(a.BCPVolume) AS Volume FROM Stat_Collection a JOIN Pub_OrgAddress b ON a.BTSID=b.InstID WHERE b.City='宁波市' AND a.BCDate>='2023-01-01' AND a.BCDate<'2024-01-01' AND a.BCType='1'

question: 列出2022年全血采集量大于零的各单位及其采集量
baseline_sql: SELECT b.InstID, b.OrgName,SUM(a.BCPVolume) AS Volume FROM Stat_Collection a JOIN Pub_OrgAddress b ON a.BTSID=b.InstID WHERE a.BCDate>='2022-01-01' AND a.BCDate<'2023-01-01' AND a.BCType='0' GROUP BY b.InstID, b.OrgName HAVING SUM(a.BCPVolume)>0

question: 查询2023年成分血采集量最高的5个机构
baseline_sql: SELECT TOP (5) b.InstID, b.OrgName,SUM(a.BCPVolume) AS Volume FROM Stat_Collection a JOIN Pub_OrgAddress b ON a.BTSID=b.InstID WHERE a.BCDate>='2023-01-01' AND a.BCDate<'2024-01-01' AND a.BCType='1' GROUP BY b.InstID, b.OrgName ORDER BY SUM(a.BCPVolume) DESC
